name: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
mandate_summary: Statutory national-level apex advisory body (statutory since AICTE Act 1987) for planning, promotion, and coordinated development of technical and management education in India.

name: National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
mandate_summary: Statutory body regulating and maintaining norms/standards for teacher education programmes and institutions across India, under the NCTE Act 1993 (enforced 1 July 1995).

name: National Council for Vocational Education and Training (NCVET)
parent_ministry_or_department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India
mandate_summary: Overarching national regulator for the technical/vocational education and training (TVET) ecosystem; sets standards, accredits awarding bodies, assessment agencies and skill councils, subsuming NSDA and erstwhile NCVT.
notes: Notified 5 December 2018; became fully operational 1 August 2020. RC2 enrichment (2026-07-22): both dates independently reconfirmed via ncvet.gov.in and Wikipedia in a fresh WebSearch pass; confidence raised (+3).

name: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education, Government of India
mandate_summary: Autonomous organisation that assists and advises the Central and State Governments on academic matters related to school education, and develops the National Curriculum Framework and NCERT textbooks.
notes: Established 27 July 1961; began formal operation 1 September 1961; formed by merger of seven earlier government organisations. RC2 enrichment (2026-07-22): 1961 founding independently reconfirmed via a fresh WebSearch pass; confidence raised (+3).

name: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education, Government of India

notes: Originated 1929 as Board of High School and Intermediate Education for Rajputana, Central India, Gwalior and Ajmer-Merwara; renamed Central Board of Secondary Education in 1952; HQ shifted to New Delhi in 1962.

name: National Testing Agency (NTA)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India

notes: Established November 2017. Headquarters at NSIC-MDBP Building, Okhla Industrial Estate, New Delhi (per search snippet).

name: National Board of Accreditation (NBA)
parent_ministry_or_department: Autonomous body under Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India (originally established by AICTE)
